# ProPilotFix

ProPilotFix 是一个修好 Proteus 9 自带 AI 助手 ProPilot「自定义服务商」连不上问题的一键补丁工具（Windows）。

## The original bug
- ProPilot's **Custom** provider class builds the request URL by `setUrl(QUrl(你的地址))` — it never appends any path.
  So it POSTs to the address you typed, verbatim: `POST /` returns **405 Method Not Allowed** ("资源仅支持 GET 或 HEAD"), `POST /v1` returns **404**.
- The same vtable's model-list builder appends only `/models` (missing `/v1`), so the model dropdown refresh also fails.
- ProPilot UI is entirely English (`source_en.ts` translations are empty), and the model dropdown's first item is hard-coded `gpt-4o`, which gets written back to the registry on OK.

## What the patch does
- Redirects two vtable slots of the Custom provider class to the standard OpenAI-compatible implementations:
  - `vtable[chat]`: `0x180086AE0` → `0x180085070` (appends `/v1/chat/completions`)
  - `vtable[models]`: `0x180086CA0` → `0x180085370` (appends `/v1/models`)
  Only 4 bytes change; PE headers, section table and `.text` stay untouched. Fully reversible.
- Keeps the Chinese UI (64 strings) and the fixed window title `ProPilotFix`.
- Does **not** write your URL / key / model — you type those inside ProPilot yourself. It only normalizes an existing registry URL to the root address.

## How to use
1. Quit Proteus 9 completely.
2. Run `ProPilotFix.exe` → it auto-locates `ProPilot.dll` → click 一键修复.
3. Open Proteus 9 → ProPilot settings → 大模型服务 → provider **自定义**:
   - 接口根地址: your root address, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:18900`, `https://api.openai.com`, `https://api.deepseek.com` — **no `/v1`, no `/chat/completions`**
   - 密钥 / 模型: your own
4. Click OK and chat. No proxy, no background process, no auto-start.
